svg.title: Delayed retry topics keep the partition moving
svg.desc: An animation in five steps. Record 3 of the ticket-orders topic fails in charge() because the payment provider answers 503. The delayed-retry-topic failure strategy writes it to ticket-orders_retry_5000 and commits its offset, so records 4 and 5 are charged and acked while it waits 5 seconds. The retry-topic consumer then hands it back to charge(), where it fails a second time and moves to ticket-orders_retry_30000. After 30 seconds the third attempt fails too, and with no retry topic left, the record lands on the dead-letter topic ticket-orders-dlq.
svg.text: Delayed retry topics keep the partition moving
With failure-strategy=delayed-retry-topic, a failed record waits out its delay in a retry topic instead of in the partition.
Delays are shortened to fit the loop.
Record 3 fails: the payment provider answers 503, charge() throws, and the record is nacked.
The failure strategy copies record 3 to ticket-orders_retry_5000 and commits its offset anyway.
Records 4 and 5 don't wait: both are charged and acked during record 3's 5 s delay.
After 5 s, the retry-topic consumer delivers record 3 to charge() again. It fails and moves to ticket-orders_retry_30000.
After 30 s, the third attempt fails too. No retry topic is left, so record 3 lands on ticket-orders-dlq.
